title: TAI plant-disease completeness and semantic acceptance repair
objective: Repair the exact-main live acceptance failure where Qwen answered the apple-scab question with only one disease-control factor group, while preserving agro-first model behavior and strengthening disease-specific answer completeness without inventing products or doses.
boundaries: Do not weaken source, model identity, answer mode, stream completeness, subject relevance, minimum answer length, forbidden platform article, RU/EN/ZH or mobile Chromium assertions

Plant-disease prevention answers must cover at least two independent relevant groups such as weather or leaf wetness, sanitation or inoculum, canopy or airflow, resistant genetics, or monitoring and label-compliant treatment timing

The deterministic completeness floor may be applied only to general-agro plant-disease questions, must remain read-only and must not name a pesticide, dose, current regulation, current weather or execution claim
The model remains the primary answer source; any bounded server-added completeness text must be disclosed by a distinct safety flag
Do not count multiple aliases inside the same factor group as multiple independent factors
The apple-scab scenario must reject an answer that contains only moisture or root-health advice and must accept sanitation plus infection-condition controls
No tenant, role, staff, private-data, write, financial-action, model transport, HMAC, secret-redaction or tool-execution boundary is changed
The one-shot workflow may modify only the registered paths on this exact branch and must remove itself before merge
No paid model, SaaS, hosting, database or recurring cost is added

Production completion requires exact-head CI, security, runtime and Kubernetes PASS, exact-main merge, REG.RU full-stack PASS, controller sync, preflight, protected activation, all endpoint and mobile Chromium cases PASS, finalization accept, deployment and postflight PASS
